questions.old_question: Can current hosted DB-time fault enablement reach backward time without replacing Ledger.now/0 with a fake source?
questions.answer: Ledger.now reads PostgreSQL clock_timestamp(). A unit test persists future crash timestamps to test conservative accounting; hosted topology exposes no PostgreSQL wall-clock step fault.
questions.proposed_catalog_edit: Tag partial; keep future-timestamp decision probe separate from a real database clock rollback.
